info.title: Peasant Local Dashboard API
info.description: Local web dashboard API for viewing AI agent session analytics. Includes REST endpoints and WebSocket channel message schemas.

BestiaryHarness.description: AI coding tool or development environment
BestiaryHarness.title: Harness

SchemaAnnotationDatatype.description: Storage type for annotation values (maps to SQLite STRICT column type)
SchemaAnnotationDatatype.title: Annotation Datatype

SchemaAnnotationStatus.description: ISO 11179 lifecycle state of an annotation type
SchemaAnnotationStatus.title: Annotation Status

SchemaAnnotatorKind.description: Type of entity that produced an annotation: human, agent (AI model), or rule (automated classifier)
SchemaAnnotatorKind.title: Annotator Kind

SchemaAssociationConclusion.description: Producer-supplied conclusion for a session-to-commit association: confirmed or candidate
SchemaAssociationConclusion.title: Association Conclusion

SchemaAssociationEvidenceKind.description: Atomic observation supporting a session-to-commit association
SchemaAssociationEvidenceKind.title: Association Evidence Kind

SchemaAssociationID.description: Opaque durable Peasant identifier for one session-to-commit association
SchemaAssociationID.title: Association ID

SchemaChangeBinding.description: Strength of the evidence connecting a recorded session to a code change
SchemaChangeBinding.title: Change Binding

SchemaConfidence.description: Strength of evidence behind a derived relationship: high, medium, or low
SchemaConfidence.title: Confidence

SchemaDiffLineKind.description: Unified-diff line kind: context, addition, or deletion
SchemaDiffLineKind.title: Diff Line Kind

SchemaEdgeViolationKind.description: Structural violation detected on a map edge
SchemaEdgeViolationKind.title: Edge Violation Kind

SchemaEntryType.description: Classification of a single entry within an agent session transcript
SchemaEntryType.title: Entry Type

SchemaFileChangeStatus.description: Git file delta status: modified, added, deleted, or renamed
SchemaFileChangeStatus.title: File Change Status

SchemaInsightKind.description: What a SessionInsight observed: a decision, friction, an unusual rate elevation, or a retry loop
SchemaInsightKind.title: Insight Kind

SchemaInsightProvenance.description: How a SessionInsight was produced: mechanical (rule-derived) or mined
SchemaInsightProvenance.title: Insight Provenance

SchemaObservedModelID.description: Exact model identifier observed on an assistant-generated turn; producer-enforced as assistant or subagent evidence. Values contain printable ASCII bytes 0x20 through 0x7E with no space at either edge; mixed case, slashes, and internal spaces are preserved.
SchemaObservedModelID.title: Observed Model ID

SchemaProjectHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the project's origin URL or local path
SchemaProjectHash.title: Project Hash

SchemaReadAttributionState.description: Whether per-file read attribution is recoverable for a node's editing sessions: complete, partial, or unavailable
SchemaReadAttributionState.title: Read Attribution State

SchemaReadStateGrade.description: Ordinal explicit read-state act: none, viewed, reviewed, or reviewed_in_detail
SchemaReadStateGrade.title: Read State Grade

SchemaRewriteMethod.description: Mechanism the resolver used to map a ghost commit to its successor
SchemaRewriteMethod.title: Rewrite Method

SchemaRewriteResolution.description: Whether a ledger-observed commit hash is live, was rewritten, or could not be resolved
SchemaRewriteResolution.title: Rewrite Resolution

SchemaRole.description: Sender role of a message turn
SchemaRole.title: Role

SchemaScaleKind.description: Stevens measurement level: nominal (categories without order), ordinal (ordered categories), continuous (numeric range)
SchemaScaleKind.title: Scale Kind

SchemaSessionID.description: Unique session identifier (UUID, agent-{hex}, ses_{id}, sess_{id} (ACP), msg_{id}, or a Strike session ID)
SchemaSessionID.title: Session ID

SchemaStopReason.description: Reason why a session or turn ended (ACP-aligned)
SchemaStopReason.title: Stop Reason

SchemaTargetKind.description: What is being annotated: session-level, entry-level (turn/tool call), meta-annotation, project-level, a specific file version (content-hash keyed read-state receipt), or a durable session-to-commit association
SchemaTargetKind.title: Target Kind

SchemaToolCallKind.description: Classification of a tool call, aligned with ACP ToolCallUpdate.kind
SchemaToolCallKind.title: Tool Call Kind

SchemaTypeOrigin.description: Who created an annotation type: system (built-in), user (individual), or group (shared)
SchemaTypeOrigin.title: Type Origin

SchemaValueDomainKind.description: ISO 11179 value domain: enumerated (finite allowed set) or described (range/pattern constraint)
SchemaValueDomainKind.title: Value Domain Kind
